title: Gateway Settings
description: System-level management: monitoring, network, time, services, security

monitor.title: System Monitor
monitor.historyDescription: View system resource usage history (CPU, Memory, Disk, Network)
monitor.cpuCoresDescription: Usage curve for each CPU core
monitor.noHistoryData: No history data available. Please wait for system collection (every 10 seconds)

config.title: Monitor Configuration
config.description: Configure monitor data collection parameters (interval, retention days, etc.)
config.monitorDescription: Configure system monitor data collection and storage parameters
config.collectionEnabledDesc: Automatically collect system resource data at specified intervals
config.collectionIntervalDesc: Data collection interval, range 5-300 seconds, default 10 seconds
config.retentionDaysDesc: History data retention days, range 1-30 days, default 7 days
config.collectNetworkDesc: Whether to collect traffic data for each network interface
config.collectProcessDesc: Whether to collect CPU and memory usage of FastAPI process
config.autoCleanupDesc: Automatically delete data older than retention days at 3:00 AM daily
config.hint: 💡 Tip: Configuration takes effect immediately, no service restart required.

network.title: Network Settings
network.description: Manage network interfaces, DNS, and gateway configuration
network.interfacesDescription: View and manage network interface configuration
network.editDNSDescription: Modify system DNS server configuration (requires system privileges)
network.editInterfaceDescription: Modify network card IP address and gateway configuration (requires system privileges)

time.title: Time Settings
time.description: Manage system clock, timezone, and NTP synchronization
time.editNTPDescription: Modify NTP server and sync settings (requires system permissions)
time.enableNTPHint: When enabled, time will be automatically synchronized with NTP servers

info.title: System Information
info.description: View system information and service status

service.title: Service Management
service.description: Manage backend services and log configuration
service.logLevelDescription: Dynamically adjust system log output level
service.warningDescription: Warning messages only, shows potential issues
service.controlHint: Note: Service control operations will be attempted, actual results depend on system permissions

security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Manage SSH, API security, and data backups
security.apiDescription: API access control and security configuration
security.backupDescription: Create and manage database backup files
security.encryptionDescription: All downloaded backup files are automatically encrypted (Fernet AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256) with .encrypted extension. Encrypted files cannot be opened directly and can only be restored through the system restore function. This prevents backup files from being analyzed or reverse engineered by others.

routes.title: Network Routes
routes.description: Manage system routing table and configure network traffic forwarding rules
routes.addRouteDescription: Add static routing rule (requires system privileges)
routes.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this route?
routes.deleteDefaultWarning: ⚠️ Warning: You are deleting the default route! This may cause network interruption. Please confirm you know what you are doing!
routes.destinationHint: Destination network in CIDR format, e.g., 192.168.1.0/24 or 0.0.0.0/0 (default route)
routes.interfaceHint: Select the outgoing interface (only shows enabled interfaces with IP)
routes.metricHint: Route priority (0-1000, lower is higher priority)
routes.warningMessage: Incorrect routing configuration may cause network failure. Please ensure you understand routing principles!

ssh.title: SSH Configuration
ssh.sshDescription: View SSH service status and configuration (requires editing system configuration files)
ssh.configHint: SSH configuration requires editing /etc/ssh/sshd_config file and restarting sshd service

software.serviceDescription: FastAPI application services: service status, log level, service control, cache management
software.servicesDescription: View FastAPI application service running status
software.apiDescription: FastAPI interface security: JWT authentication, rate limiting, CORS configuration
software.databaseDescription: Application data management: database backup, restore
software.readOnlyHint: You are an Operator. You can only view the configuration, not modify it. Please contact a Developer for changes.
software.apiConfigHint: API security configuration requires modifying JWT_EXPIRE_MINUTES, RATE_LIMIT, CORS_ORIGINS in .env file and restarting the application

restore.title: Restore Database Backup
restore.step1_description: Step 1: Select and upload backup file
restore.step2_description: Step 2: Validate backup file and confirm restore
restore.warning_message: This operation will overwrite the current database! The current database will be automatically backed up, but please proceed with caution.
restore.safety_backup_message: Current database will be automatically backed up before restore. Filename format: app_before_restore_timestamp.db
restore.force_restore_hint: Only check this if you confirm the backup is from a different machine or project
restore.confirm_hint: Please type RESTORE in uppercase to confirm the restore operation
restore.please_wait: Please do not close this page. Database restore takes a few seconds.
restore.page_refresh_hint: Restore successful! Page will refresh in 1.5 seconds...
restore.success_message: Database has been successfully restored. Here is the detailed report:
restore.no_changes_message: The restored backup is identical to the current database, with no data changes.
restore.refresh_required_message: To ensure the interface displays the latest data, please click the button below to refresh the page.
restore.failure_message: An error occurred during database restore. Please see details below:
restore.rollback_success_message: Restore failed detected. System has automatically rolled back to previous state. Your data is safe with no loss.
restore.rollback_failed_message: Restore failed and rollback also failed! Please check database files immediately and restore manually if necessary. Safety backup should be in backups/ directory.
restore.suggestion_check_file: Check if backup file is corrupted (try opening with SQLite tools)
restore.suggestion_check_permission: Check file permissions (ensure app has read/write access)
restore.suggestion_check_disk: Check disk space (ensure sufficient space available)
restore.suggestion_contact_admin: If problem persists, contact system administrator with error details above

error.no_file_selected: Please select a backup file first
error.invalid_confirm_text: Invalid confirm text. Please type RESTORE
